subject: Service reprieve authorization request — Pioneer Analytics production latency impact
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@pioneer-analytics.com>, Pioneer Analytics Ops <ops@pioneer-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T16:12:00Z
Subject: Service reprieve authorization request — Pioneer Analytics production latency impact

Evan —

First, sincere apologies for the latency you saw during the Aug 20th production window. Our post-incident analysis (attached) shows a cache misconfiguration combined with an autoscaling delay on our Dedicated pool that resulted in elevated tail latency for ~3 hours.

I want to propose a one-time customer concession and request exec authorization to proceed:
- Bill credit: 30% of the August invoice for affected services (one-off).
- Operational relief: one month of waived Dedicated capacity fees (applies to their reserved cluster).

Attachments: incident_timeline_20260821.pdf, usage_report_august_export.csv, customer_impact_summary.docx, proposed_concession_calc.xlsx

I don’t have authority to exceed our standard SLA credit formula (which covers partial credits up to an automatic cap). Pioneer is asking for something outside the automated calculation given the business impact they described in the call. Asking Laura and Karthik to weigh in on the commercial side and Marissa for exec approval if we need to go above the standard cap.

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) Internal approval thread for any one-off concession beyond standard SLO credits.
2) If approved, update the customer-facing email and schedule a 30-minute sync with Pioneer today to finalize wording.

Thanks — I’ll summarize the calc in the attached sheet but high-level numbers: the proposed combination would be roughly equivalent to a $60k–$95k concession depending on whether we apply a waived month or larger bill credit.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@pioneer-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Service reprieve authorization request — Pioneer Analytics production latency impact

Aditya —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and for the analysis. The outage knocked a set of scheduled inference pipelines and caused delayed reporting to several downstream customers — we had to triage manually for ~6 hours. That had measurable revenue and SLA penalties on our end.

Given the disruption, the team is asking for stronger remediation than the standard automated credit. At minimum we need:
- One full month waived on the Dedicated cluster AND
- A bill credit to offset the lost revenue tied to the late delivery (we estimated a conservative $85k impact).

If Redwood can’t meet both items, we need a clear, escalated offer now so we can present it to our finance team by EOD. We appreciate the transparency — hoping we can land on something fast.

—Evan
Evan Brooks
VP of Ops, Pioneer Analytics
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T20:15:00Z
Subject: RE: Service reprieve authorization request — Pioneer Analytics production latency impact

Aditya / Karthik —

Reviewing the attachments and Pioneer’s note: the ask is outside our SLO algorithm. Recommendation from commercial POV:
- Offer: one waived month on Dedicated OR a 25% bill credit for August, plus a one-time additional $10k goodwill credit for the exec-level relationship.
- Cap: total concession not to exceed $85,000.
- Conditions: require signed addendum to SLA specifying operational remediation timelines, and commitment to a 12-month renewal or renewed purchase order.

Rationale: gives Pioneer a meaningful makewhole while keeping us within a conservative cost band. If they push for $85k–$100k, route to Marissa for one-off exec approval.

I attached a quick calc (proposed_concession_calc.xlsx) with the scenarios. If Karthik signs off, we should get Marissa’s OK and then present a written offer to Evan.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T15:02:00Z
Subject: RE: Service reprieve authorization request — Service reprieve authorization request — Pioneer Analytics production latency impact

Marissa —

Quick summary and recommendation for exec approval: Pioneer experienced ~3 hours of elevated tail latency on Aug 20th; business impact escalated internally at their end. They asked for: one month waived + additional bill credit to cover lost revenue (~$85k ask).

My recommended concession (balanced):
- One-time offer: 25% credit on the August invoice OR one waived month of Dedicated (whichever is greater), plus a $10k goodwill credit.
- Absolute cap: $100,000.
- Approval ask: if you approve up to $85k, we can close quickly; anything above requires your discretionary sign-off for the remaining up to $100k.

If approved, we will:
1) Send a formal offer to Evan with the conditions Laura outlined (SLA addendum + 12-month commit).
2) Finance will issue a pro forma credit memo and ops will schedule the waived-month adjustment.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-78932 (contains ARR and subscription details).

Can you confirm asap? Pioneer needs an offer to present to their Finance team today.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T00:08:00Z
Subject: RE: Service reprieve authorization request — Pioneer Analytics production latency impact

Team —

Thanks for the clear recommendation and the calc worksheets. Approve moving forward with the customer-facing offer with the following limits and conditions:
- Approve: 25% credit on Aug invoice + $10k goodwill credit.
- Cap: total exposure not to exceed $85,000.
- Condition: customer must sign the SLA addendum (remediation timelines) and a 12-month renewal commitment (or confirmed renewed PO) before credit is applied.
- Communications: Sales to own the language; Finance will issue the credit memo once the signed addendum and renewal confirmation are received.

Aditya / Karthik: please draft the customer email, include the attachments we used as reference, and propose a short contract addendum for legal to review. I want the customer outreach to be empathetic and clear about the conditions.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
